bullets.text: Heavy rains lashed Chennai and suburbs overnight and into Deepavali day, prompting the office to monitor waterlogging and relief efforts.
A young woman was brutally murdered by her alleged lover in Pennalurpet, Tiruvallur district, and the office should track the police investigation.
The Greater Chennai Corporation repaired 1,531 of 13,227 potholes after rains, and the office should push for faster road restoration across affected routes.
Chennai faces AQI monitoring gaps as sensors fail ahead of Deepavali smoke, and the office should urge authorities to restore data feeds.
Rain clouds cleared over Chennai to allow Deepavali celebrations, and the district team should monitor weather improvements across Thiruvallur.
Thiruttani Murugan temple announced time restrictions for Kandha Sashti festival starting November 10, and the office should monitor crowd management arrangements.
The Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad brought 450 global delegates to discuss urbanisation and AI, and the portfolio team should review potential technology collaborations.
